posts.name: vishal sharma
posts.cooked: Hello, i would like to express my concern over the grade of system command i have not been able to give oppe because i couldn’t doo my bpts on time, i thought i would repeat the bpts and would clear the oppe and system commands course. But in course grade i have recieved 34 marks which is short of 1 mark to be 35 which is the eligibility to attempt the oppe in the next term. I am short of just 1 marks. Please on the grace basis or courtesy basis pass my threshold by increasing one marks, its a very great request since in next term is my last term and i already have four subjects to take. If i have to take another term for diploma i would be having lots of difficulties because i would be left only with 3 terms to complete my degree which is impossible, so please increase my 1 mark and please make me able to just re appear into the oppe in the next term so that i am able to finish the diploma in the next term pleaseeeee

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
One thing you are mistaken there is a cap of 4 year to complete diploma only and once you complete it and move to degree level that 4 year cap is no longer imposed. So, you can complete your degree comfortably in more than 3 terms. Also, grace marks cannot be provided as it would be unfair to others.

Note - 4 years (12 terms) is counted from the date you start your diploma level

posts.name: vishal sharma
posts.cooked:
I was referring overall completion in 4 years and second thing is that it has happened in the past that one of my friend was short of one marks in business analytics course and he requested the team and they increased the threshold on the grounds of grace thats why i am seeking for it. Please do that else my overall degree duration would increase 4 year cap and since i am standalone it would cast a very bad image on my future. When i complete my bpts and will do oppe i will be having good grade in system commands this evaluation in which i am failing is without bpts amd oppe thats why i am seeking for the increase of just 1 marks pleaseeeee sir

vishal sharma

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: There is no such cap of 4 years on entire degree, please go through the student handbook to clear out such doubts.
